transparent_scenario_not_guarantee.basis: slowest observed average epoch among these full optimizer runs: synthetic V1 = 2324.5228/42 = 55.35 s/epoch; at max100 epochs approx 1.54 h/run
transparent_scenario_not_guarantee.core_run_count_assumption: six trainable full variants V0,V1,V2,V3,V4,V9 x three primary datasets x five formal seeds = 90 model runs; V5-V8 reuse frozen checkpoints
transparent_scenario_not_guarantee.interpretation: This observed-slowest-epoch scenario exceeds the entire 72h envelope before external baselines, robustness, validation calibration, profiles and report work. It is a conservative planning scenario only, not a claim that unknown runs cost the same. No valid full-matrix completion estimate can be made until ongoing run totals and representative epoch costs exist.
